scenes.title: Moon 7 · fine-tuned
scenes.description: An unseen simulated lunar scene after small-sample adaptation. Each future view is predicted from four observed frames and the recorded target pose.
scenes.descriptionZh: An unseen simulated lunar scene after small-sample adaptation. Each future view is predicted from four observed frames and the recorded target pose.
scenes.provenance: OpenNWM Nav15 Stage 2, fine-tuned for 1,000 steps on 30 LuSNAR windows (480 target pairs). Moon 7–9 were held out. Four observed context frames; direct horizons 1–16; DDPM 250, seed 0, VAE posterior means. All 16 predictions play at 4 FPS without interpolation. Recorded capture offsets are retained in the manifest. Lunar appearance improves, but geometry and autoregressive consistency remain imperfect; this is not a physical-navigation result.

scenes.title: The Moon
scenes.description: Fine-tuned OpenNWM and NWM share the same initial image and forward controls. The real Yutu-2 image tests transfer from fine-tuning on simulated LuSNAR only.
scenes.descriptionZh: Fine-tuned OpenNWM and NWM share the same initial image and forward controls. The real Yutu-2 image tests transfer from fine-tuning on simulated LuSNAR only.
scenes.provenance: Both models were fine-tuned for 1,000 steps on the same 30 LuSNAR windows (480 target pairs). The real Yutu-2 image tests transfer from fine-tuning on simulated LuSNAR only. A single image is repeated into four context frames; synthetic forward action 0.75 per step, 16 autoregressive steps, DDPM 250, seed 0, VAE posterior means. Videos play at 4 FPS without interpolation. There is no paired future reference or calibrated distance/time. Appearance and geometry may drift; this is not a physical-navigation result.

scenes.title: Mars
scenes.description: A real Martian observation from Tianwen-1 / Zhurong, conditioned on a forward path.
scenes.descriptionZh: A real Martian observation from Tianwen-1 / Zhurong, conditioned on a forward path.
scenes.provenance: OpenNWM · Nav15 Stage 2 joint100k · DDPM 250 · seed 0 · VAE posterior mean. Autoregressive prediction feeds each generated image back into the model. Severe appearance drift was observed in these planetary rollouts. These are qualitative stress tests, not proof of arbitrary-scene or physical navigation capability. 16 model steps are displayed at 4 FPS; real mission capture intervals are irregular.
